assets.label: 成熟茶树
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent mature tea shrub sprite, the master design for a four-stage tea-growth set in a Chinese pale-watercolor garden game. Input image 1 is the CURRENT painting and subdued palette reference (rounded-leaf ornamental shrub): follow its broad clean watercolor washes and soft grey-sage values, NOT its leaf species. Input image 2 is the CURRENT scene style reference only. Input image 3 is the OLD tea plant for botanical identification only; replace its excessive leaf detail, dark woody texture and bright lime buds. Primary request: completely redraw ONE mature harvest-ready Camellia sinensis tea bush in the current refined, calm Chinese ink and pale mineral-watercolor style. It must unmistakably be a tea shrub: restrained elongated oval leaves with gently pointed tips, a small number of fresh paired tea shoots. Build the coherent asymmetrical low domed canopy from about 9–12 broad connected leaf masses; use roughly 25–40 large simplified visible tea leaves, mainly silhouette leaves and a few overlapping front leaves, NOT hundreds of individually outlined leaves. Very short understated warm-grey-brown forked woody base, mostly hidden by the low foliage. Rounded broad silhouette about 1.7–1.9 times wider than full plant height. Muted dusty grey-sage, celadon and chalk olive leaves; fresh shoots are quiet pale sage-cream, never yellow or neon lime. Thin warm grey ink contours, broad calm 2–3-tone paint shapes, gentle edge clarity, minimal vein marks only on a few major front leaves, almost no grain. Clean and readable at 110–150 pixels wide in-game, lighter contrast than architecture, softly integrated with the backdrop without blurring. Entire complete unclipped plant, with generous transparent margins. Bottom rooted base centered, natural slight elevated game view. Genuine RGBA transparent exterior and gaps, no shadow matte. No flowers, berries, soil, ground slab, pot, rocks, props, other plants, labels, text, watermark, collage, sprite sheet, over-detailed texture, speckles, noise, muddy colors, saturated green, black outlines, glossy 3D or photorealism. Only one plant.

assets.label: 茶树采摘后
assets.subject: ONE freshly harvested version of EXACTLY the same mature tea shrub as image 1. Preserve the mature shrub's short woody base, broad canopy width, orientation and major leafy mass placement. Remove the upright pale new tea shoots from the crown and sides, replacing those pick points with a few small clean gaps and lower calm rounded tea-leaf tips. Keep the healthy grey-sage mature leaves, full established bush rather than bare sticks. Canopy is subtly 10–15 percent lower and slightly tidier after picking, with NO bright new harvest-ready tips. Do not shrink it back into a seedling or change its underlying bush identity.
